shortDescription: MAUMEE, Ohio, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dana Incorporated (NYSE:DAN) ("Dana" or the "Company") announced today the pricing, expiration and results of its tender offers to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding 4.250% Senior Notes due 2030 (the "2030 Notes") and 4.500% Senior Notes due…

children: ) ("Dana" or the "Company") announced today the pricing, expiration and results of its tender offers to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding 4.250% Senior Notes due 2030 (the "2030 Notes") and 4.500% Senior Notes due 2032 (the "2032 Notes" and, together with the 2030 Notes, the "Notes"). The tender offers (each, an "Offer" and, together, the "Offers") were made pursuant to the Offer to Purchase, dated November 6, 2026 (the "Offer to Purchase"). The Offers expired at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on November 13, 2026 (the "Expiration Date").

According to information provided by D.F. King & Co., Inc., the tender and information agent for the Offers, $357,873,000 aggregate principal amount of Notes were validly tendered by the Expiration Date and not validly withdrawn by the Withdrawal Deadline (as defined in the Offer to Purchase). The table below includes information about the aggregate principal amount of Notes referred to above broken out between 2030 Notes and 2032 Notes. The table below also shows pricing information regarding the Notes, including the Consideration (as defined below) for the Notes, calculated as of 3:00 p.m., New York City time, today, November 13, 2026, in accordance with the Offer to Purchase.
No representation is made as to the correctness or accuracy of the CUSIP numbers or ISINs listed in this news release or printed on the Notes.
Such information is provided solely for the convenience of the holders of the Notes (each, a "Holder" and, collectively, the "Holders").
Reflects the consideration (the "Consideration") for each $1,000 principal amount of Notes of each series validly tendered, not validly withdrawn and
accepted for purchase pursuant to the Offers. In addition to the Consideration, Holders whose Notes are accepted for purchase pursuant to the Offers
will also receive accrued interest ("Accrued Interest") on such Notes from the last interest payment date of such Notes to, but not including, November
17, 2026 (the "Settlement Date"). Interest will cease to accrue on the Settlement Date for all Notes accepted for purchase.

The Company intends to accept for purchase the principal amount of the Notes specified in the table above and pay the applicable Consideration and Accrued Interest for such Notes on the Settlement Date.

To the extent any Notes remain outstanding following the consummation of the Offers, the Company currently intends to (but is not obligated to) defease all covenants (except payment of principal and interest and maintenance of office) with respect to one or both series of Notes, in which case Holders of such Notes will continue to receive interest on each scheduled interest payment date and principal on the stated maturity date but will not benefit from any restrictive covenants removed pursuant to the defeasance, including the change of control repurchase obligations.
The description of the Offers above is only a summary and is qualified in its entirety by the Offer to Purchase.

The Company retained J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Barclays Capital Inc. as dealer managers in connection with the Offers (the "Dealer Managers"). In such capacities, they may contact Holders regarding the Offers and may request brokers, dealers, commercial banks, trust companies and other nominees or intermediaries to forward the Offer to Purchase and related materials to beneficial owners of Notes. ) is a global leader in the design and manufacture of highly efficient propulsion solutions for the light- and commercial vehicle markets. The company supplies leading vehicle manufacturers and related aftermarkets with industry defining drive systems, electrodynamic technologies, and thermal and sealing solutions.
